item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.1:
The Hunter's Guide

Issued by Rust Anchor Station


For you, newly dropped at the edge. Read it, then go.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.2:
THE WORLD

This is the edge of the world. The mist came in from the sea and swallowed the lighthouses, and the roads.

Rust Anchor Station sits outside it and drops hunters into the zone, one by one.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.3:
THE TASK

In the zone, the Lighthouse Keepers guard the Salt of the Rust God.

Find a lighthouse, bring down its keeper, carry the salt back. That is why you were dropped.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.4:
SALT

Salt is the only currency here. Defeat what you face and you earn it.

Found a salt pouch? Use it in your hand to add its salt to yours.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.5:
RESIDUE

Your salt and gear stay in the grave, except the safe box. Find it on the map and right-click it to take them back.

Fall again first and the salt fades. The gear drops by the grave.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.6:
GOLDEN BELLS

Ring a bell to set your respawn point. Each bell needs an hour of real time before it can ring again.

A fragile ore bell rings only once and calls its first hunter back once.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.7:
DROP STATIONS

Hunter drop stations stand across the land, with supplies in the barrel and a one-time bell on the pad.

Where you woke is no true station: broken, or someone's copy.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.8:
TIERS AND PACKS

The colour of the ◆ is the tier: rust, grey, green, blue, purple, gold, red.

Packs have cells and things take room by size. What is in the safe box stays when you fall.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.9:
WEAPONS

Wood, stone, iron, diamond, netherite: each makes a blade, greatsword, spear, dagger, hammer and scythe.

M zooms the minimap; R turns what you carry.

May you come back.

title.mistinn.tagline: A hunter sent by Rust Anchor walks into the zone at the world's edge.
title.mistinn.splash.1: A road in the fog only counts once you've walked it.
title.mistinn.splash.2: Rust Anchor keeps numbers. The sea remembers footsteps.
title.mistinn.splash.3: You heard the bell. It heard you, too.
title.mistinn.splash.4: No light on this shore guides you home.
title.mistinn.splash.5: The light went out. The night watch stayed.
title.mistinn.splash.6: The tide goes out. Salt debts stay.
title.mistinn.splash.9: Some doors are locked from the far side of the sea.
title.mistinn.splash.10: Keep your flame low. The fog can see it.
title.mistinn.splash.11: The green on old copper is the sea's fingerprint.
title.mistinn.splash.12: The top looks close. Try the stairs.
title.mistinn.splash.13: The wind slipped through a broken pane and took a word.
title.mistinn.splash.14: A map only has room for one way to get lost.
title.mistinn.splash.15: Every anchor on the shore once thought it would go home.
title.mistinn.splash.16: Wet stone remembers the shape of your boots.
title.mistinn.splash.17: Someone listens where no echo comes back.
title.mistinn.splash.18: A little more fog, a little less shore.
title.mistinn.splash.19: Find the light. Then see what's making it.
title.mistinn.splash.20: Don't call that distant lighthouse home just yet.
title.mistinn.splash.21: The wind sounds softer under a golden bell.
title.mistinn.splash.22: No pocketful of salt can hold the whole sea.
title.mistinn.splash.23: The trip ends when you recover your residue.
title.mistinn.splash.24: Leave one pocket for the way back.
title.mistinn.splash.25: You can rotate your gear. Good luck rotating your luck.
title.mistinn.splash.26: Armour wears out. So do you.
title.mistinn.splash.27: Did both legs agree to that jump?
title.mistinn.splash.30: The handbook won't teach you how to look brave.
title.mistinn.splash.31: A splint can steady a limb. Courage is on you.
title.mistinn.splash.32: The radio only receives. Save your complaints.
title.mistinn.splash.33: The radio works again. An answer never came.
title.mistinn.splash.34: Know where you'll go before you ring the bell.
title.mistinn.splash.35: Why does the Snuffer carry a lantern?
title.mistinn.splash.36: Did you hear the chain go taut?
title.mistinn.splash.37: The salt at your feet knows it's about to jump.
title.mistinn.splash.38: The keeper waits for everyone. You're not late.
title.mistinn.splash.39: Four lamps are enough to fight in the dark.
title.mistinn.splash.40: There's always wind on the last floor of the tower.
title.mistinn.splash.41: Gravestones tell fewer lies than maps.
title.mistinn.splash.42: Salt on your hem is a little sea you can't return to.
title.mistinn.splash.43: Rust Anchor still hasn't sent a ticket home.
title.mistinn.splash.44: The recovery pod is open. Take your time.
title.mistinn.splash.45: Let the wave pass. Listen for the bell again.
title.mistinn.splash.46: Things the fog swallows don't always sink.
title.mistinn.splash.47: You can wait for dawn. So can the lighthouse.
title.mistinn.splash.48: If the tide runs backward, don't follow.
title.mistinn.splash.49: Even dented copper catches the dusk.
title.mistinn.splash.50: Next time, let's meet somewhere without a gravestone.
mode.mistinn.title: How will this exile go?
mode.mistinn.story.desc: Follow Rust Anchor's orders into the zone. Begin with The Drop, then climb the fog-shore lighthouse in Chapter 1.
mode.mistinn.free.desc: No orders and no end. The world is just as dangerous, and the lighthouses still wait on the coast.
mode.mistinn.training.desc: Report to Rust Anchor's offshore training yard. Board a drop pod to choose Story or Free exploration after the course.
mode.mistinn.hint: Finish training to choose your deployment.
hardship.mistinn.title: How hard will it be?
hardship.mistinn.normal.tagline: The fog shore as it is.
hardship.mistinn.easy.desc: Blows land softer, wounds and broken bones are rarer, injuries heal faster and hunger comes slower. Falling works as in Normal: your salt and what you carried wait in the gravestone for you to come back for.
hardship.mistinn.normal.desc: The fog shore as it is: blows, bleeding, broken bones, healing and hunger as they always were. When you fall, your salt and what you carried wait in the gravestone for you to come back for; the safe box is 2x2.
hardship.mistinn.rust_anchor.desc: Live by the station's rules: only its food stays down, and food from outside goes damp in your hands; weapons from outside hit soft and break fast. Blows land harder, wounds and broken bones come easier, injuries heal slowly and hunger comes fast, and a limb can be lost for good, until you die. When you fall, the gear you carried wears down, four tenths of your salt is lost, and you wake at half strength. The safe box grows to 3x3.
training.mistinn.complete.title: Hunter Training Complete
training.mistinn.lesson.arrival.hint: Leave the barracks and find Steelyard, the quartermaster, at the stores on the quay.
training.mistinn.lesson.arrival.radio: 3412, awake? It's your drop day. First, draw your kit at the stores on the quay.
training.mistinn.lesson.quartermaster.hi: Right-click Steelyard, the quartermaster, to hear how to draw your kit.
training.mistinn.lesson.gear.hint: Open the supply chest on the left. Press %3$s to equip your armor, rig and backpack. Right-click the helmet slot to switch to the mask slot.
training.mistinn.lesson.gear.radio: Tier colors tell you what you are wearing. Armor only protects the parts it covers. Check yours before you head out.
training.mistinn.lesson.pack.hint: Take the splint from the chest. Pick it up in your inventory, press R to turn it, and put it in your backpack. The safe box keeps items through death.
training.mistinn.lesson.sprint.hint: Go east from the forge to the drill yard. Sprint along the lane with %2$s and watch your stamina.
training.mistinn.lesson.sprint.radio: Keep an eye on that bar. When you run it dry in the zone, you'll be standing still waiting for it.
training.mistinn.lesson.roll.hint: Press %1$s to roll in the lane. Let your stamina recover before trying again.
training.mistinn.lesson.strike.hint: In the ring at the middle of the drill yard, use the Anchor Blade in your hotbar to defeat the practice target. Leave time to recover between swings.
training.mistinn.lesson.strike.radio: That's an Anchor Blade. A spear has reach. A greatsword has weight. Learn when your swing starts and when it lets you move again.
training.mistinn.lesson.salt.hint: Defeated creatures give salt. Right-click the salt in your hotbar to bring your total to 20.
training.mistinn.lesson.tourniquet.hint: Cross the listening pen to the infirmary in the east. Check the bleeding marker on your left arm, then right-click the tourniquet and finish applying it.
training.mistinn.lesson.tourniquet.radio: You can be hurt in six places. Your left arm is bleeding. A tourniquet buys you time, but leaving it on too long hurts the arm.
training.mistinn.lesson.splint.hint: Your left leg is fractured. Right-click the splint to brace it for a while. An unbraced fracture turns a roll into a dive.
training.mistinn.lesson.painkiller.hint: Right-click the painkillers. The dose will mask injuries for a while.
training.mistinn.lesson.surgery.hint: Right-click the surgery kit to treat your left leg. Avoid attacking or rolling during treatment.
training.mistinn.lesson.injector.hint: Right-click the potent injector and watch the injured parts recover. A destroyed part needs surgery.
training.mistinn.lesson.repair.hint: Wear the training armor and right-click the tier III armor repair kit. Let the repair finish.
training.mistinn.lesson.craft.hint: Go south to the workshop and use the recipe book at its table to craft a one-use bell from five raw gold and one iron chain. It can bring you back once.
training.mistinn.lesson.bell.hint: Right-click the bell to bind your respawn here. The bell is also marked on your map.
training.mistinn.lesson.bell.radio: Listen to the bell. You're about to hear it a second time.
training.mistinn.lesson.fall.hint: Walk onto the gold practice plate before the bell tower to experience death and respawn.
training.mistinn.lesson.fall.radio: This is an exercise. The bell will bring you back.
training.mistinn.lesson.recover.hint: Return to the mission and follow the map from the bell to your grave. Press %4$s to retrieve your salt and gear.
training.mistinn.lesson.recover.radio: Remember where you fell. Fall a second time and the old residue fades.
training.mistinn.lesson.radio.hint: Go west to the radio room, hold the four redstone pieces and right-click the broken radio. In Story, use K to review calls in your journal.
training.mistinn.lesson.radio.radio: Lost the signal? Bridge the contacts with redstone. I'll be there when the static clears.
training.mistinn.lesson.lamps.hint: Go to the lamp hall in the west and right-click the four stands in its corners to light them.
training.mistinn.lesson.lamps.radio: We've made a practice echo of the keeper. If it snuffs the lamps, light all four to knock it off balance.
training.mistinn.lesson.keeper.hint: Roll when it winds up and strike after it swings. Relight the stands when it darkens the room.
training.mistinn.lesson.report.hint: Climb from the lamp hall's north gate to the drop platform, hold the Rust God's Salt and right-click the radio at the hand-over console.
training.mistinn.lesson.report.radio: Sample received. That was your final handoff before the shore. Your pod is waiting.
training.mistinn.lesson.board.hint: Walk into the drop pod and right-click the control button to take your seat.
training.mistinn.lesson.board.radio: 3412, take your seat and strap in. When that hatch shuts, the rest is up to you.
training.mistinn.lesson.deploy.hint: Choose Story or Free exploration from inside the pod.
death.mistinn.title: MISSION TERMINATED
death.mistinn.quote.creature.0: Your number was not issued to be spent like this.
death.mistinn.quote.creature.1: If you cannot get past what lives by the road, forget the lighthouse.
death.mistinn.quote.creature.2: Another one. It goes in the report as it happened.
death.mistinn.quote.creature.3: Get up. Nothing in the mist waits for you to catch your breath.
death.mistinn.quote.execution.0: Your legs gave out. Something in the mist saw it happen.
death.mistinn.quote.execution.1: One more step. You only needed one more step.
death.mistinn.quote.execution.2: You heard the footsteps, but you could no longer stand.
death.mistinn.quote.execution.3: Don't leave your last breath there. Come back.
death.mistinn.quote.keeper.0: The keeper has seen plenty like you. Do not let it remember you.
death.mistinn.quote.keeper.1: You went down exactly the way the others did.
death.mistinn.quote.keeper.2: It is still standing. You know what that means.
death.mistinn.quote.keeper.3: It still holds the salt. We cannot wait long.
death.mistinn.quote.fall.0: If you cannot keep your feet, how will you reach the top of a lighthouse?
death.mistinn.quote.fall.1: The zone has no railings. Look before you jump.
death.mistinn.quote.fall.2: A hunter who falls to death gets two words in the report.
death.mistinn.quote.fall.3: We did not drop you at the bottom of a cliff.
death.mistinn.quote.hunger.0: Starve in the zone and the station records you as a deserter.
death.mistinn.quote.hunger.1: You brought a backpack and left your sense behind.
death.mistinn.quote.hunger.2: Salt is not food. I did not think that needed teaching.
death.mistinn.quote.hunger.3: Supplies do not grow out of the mist.
death.mistinn.quote.drowning.0: The water in the mist is deeper than you think.
death.mistinn.quote.drowning.1: You are a hunter, not an anchor. Stop sinking.
death.mistinn.quote.drowning.2: The sea keeps no salt. Look up next time.
death.mistinn.quote.drowning.3: Do I have to remind you to breathe?
death.mistinn.quote.fire.0: Salt burned to ash cannot be gathered again.
death.mistinn.quote.fire.1: Fire takes no sides. You should know better than it does.
death.mistinn.quote.fire.3: Get out of the fire first. Think after.
death.mistinn.quote.other.0: The mission is still here. You are not.
death.mistinn.quote.other.1: That was not courage. That was a wasted number.
death.mistinn.quote.other.2: The anchor is still rusting. You have no time to lie there.
death.mistinn.quote.other.3: I will not say I am sorry. Come back and finish it.
message.mistinn.story.caught_up: Your team went on with the story while you were away. Now: %s
story.mistinn.step.salt.hint: Defeat creatures, or use salt found in the ruins.
story.mistinn.step.station.hint: The back of the guide marks the nearest one; the diamond on the minimap shows it.
story.mistinn.step.radio.hint: Hold 4 redstone and use the radio.
story.mistinn.step.lighthouse.hint: The amber diamond on the minimap marks the lighthouse.
story.mistinn.step.bell: Rest at the golden bell by the lighthouse door
story.mistinn.step.bell.hint: Use the bell. Ringing it sets your respawn point. If it is cooling down, you can still head upstairs.
story.mistinn.step.lamp_room.hint: Follow the spiral stairs up the tower.
story.mistinn.step.snuffer.hint: When every lamp goes out, light the four lamp stands and it loses its footing.
story.mistinn.step.deliver: Hand the Rust God's salt block in at a drop station
story.mistinn.step.deliver.hint: Hold the salt block and use the radio of an intact drop station.
story.mistinn.step.wait: Wait for word from Rust Anchor
story.mistinn.step.wait.hint: The next chapter is still being written.
story.mistinn.journal.free: This world is free exploration: there is no mission.
message.mistinn.radio.broken: The radio's wiring has burned out. It needs %s redstone.
message.mistinn.radio.dead: This radio is long past mending.
story.mistinn.card.drop.0: The bell of Rust Anchor Station tolled three times.
story.mistinn.card.drop.1: The drop pod left its cradle and fell into the mist at the edge of the world.
story.mistinn.card.drop.2: Inside were a guide, a number tag, and you.
story.mistinn.card.drop.4: When you woke, the pod was gone. Around you stood a drop station no one had used in years.
item.mistinn.pig_fat.usage: Eaten raw it may leave you hungry; render it in a furnace or over a campfire.
item.mistinn.beef_tallow.usage: Eaten raw it may leave you hungry; render it into cracklings.
item.mistinn.beef_sinew.usage: Takes a long chew. Roasting helps.
item.mistinn.mutton_fat.usage: Eaten raw it may leave you hungry; roast it, or stir it into mushroom mash.
item.mistinn.chicken_scraps.usage: Backs, necks and feet. Raw, they leave you hungry.
item.mistinn.fish_offal.usage: Heads and guts; raw, they turn the stomach. Grill them, or boil them with kelp.
item.mistinn.pork_cracklings.lore.1: A handful in the porridge makes a good day, says the cook.
item.mistinn.roasted_sinew.lore.1: Chewy, and it keeps you going.
item.mistinn.hardtack.usage: Four wheat pressed into two. Hard enough to drive nails.
item.mistinn.kelp_cake.usage: Three kelp and a wheat, pressed into two.
item.mistinn.drippings_porridge.usage: A bowl, wheat and pork cracklings.
item.mistinn.bone_broth.usage: A bowl, two bones and a piece of fat.
item.mistinn.offal_soup.usage: A bowl, fish offal and kelp. The station has it every day.
item.mistinn.mushroom_mash.usage: A bowl, a brown and a red mushroom, and mutton fat.
item.mistinn.ration_biscuit.lore.1: Rust Anchor's ration, the paper stamped in rust red.
item.mistinn.rust_can.lore.1: The seam has rusted. Best not to think about it.
item.mistinn.damp_food.usage: Eat it and your stomach never stretches as far again.
item.mistinn.damp_food.lore.1: By Rust Anchor's rules, food from outside spoils the moment it is in your hands.
message.mistinn.food.damp: The %s in your hands has gone damp.
message.mistinn.food.spoiled: Your stomach turns. You can't eat as much any more.
message.mistinn.food.spoiled_floor: Your stomach turns, but it can't get any worse.
message.mistinn.food.cake: By Rust Anchor's rules, that isn't food.
message.mistinn.bell.unlit: This bell's lamp is out. It needs oil.
story.mistinn.card.lighthouse.0: One by one, the lighthouses on the coast went dark.
story.mistinn.card.lighthouse.1: No one remembers who lit the last lamp.
story.mistinn.card.lighthouse.2: Only that the mist has not lifted since.
story.mistinn.card.unanswered.0: The recovery pod did not rise.
story.mistinn.card.unanswered.1: The salt lay quiet at the bottom of the pod, as if waiting for someone to take it.
story.mistinn.card.unanswered.2: Mist rolled in from the sea. Far off, the lighthouse went dark again.
story.mistinn.step.listen: Listen for the bell at night
story.mistinn.step.listen.hint: Stay outside after dark. Something sounds through the fog.
story.mistinn.step.cairn_1.hint: Go the way the bell sounded. Something lies under the cairn.
story.mistinn.step.cairn_2.hint: Cairn after cairn, toward the sea.
story.mistinn.step.cairn_3.hint: The last one stands by the sea.
story.mistinn.step.bell_station.hint: The tower on the reef. The diamond on the minimap points to it.
story.mistinn.step.bell_rest: Rest at the fog-bell station's golden bell
story.mistinn.step.bell_rest.hint: A golden bell hangs in the shrine by the jetty. Right-click to ring it.
story.mistinn.step.belfry.hint: The stair climbs along the tower wall. Once you are up, the fog closes the way behind you.
story.mistinn.step.sunken_bell.hint: Every toll thickens the fog. A full heavy blow rings its own bell and clears it.
story.mistinn.step.ring.hint: Right-click the great bell in the middle of the belfry.
story.mistinn.radio.night_toll.0: A bell sounds through the fog.
story.mistinn.radio.night_toll.1: Once, twice, three times. Just as on the day you were dropped.
story.mistinn.radio.tag_1.0: The bell rings out at sea. I'm going to look, and I'll tell the others when I'm back.
story.mistinn.radio.tag_2.0: The salt dead get up when the bell rings. Every toll, one more on the road.
story.mistinn.radio.tag_3.0: I saw the one in the belfry.
story.mistinn.radio.tag_3.1: He was wearing the station's uniform.
story.mistinn.radio.sunken_bell_end.1: You came following the bell too. So did I.
story.mistinn.radio.sunken_bell_end.2: I rang the bell at Rust Anchor for twenty years. One sent down, three tolls.
story.mistinn.radio.sunken_bell_end.3: Then they sent me down as well.
story.mistinn.radio.sunken_bell_end.4: This bell was never for the ships. It tells them up there: someone down here is still alive.
story.mistinn.card.salt_road.0: From the drop station toward the sea, someone once marked a road with salt.
story.mistinn.card.salt_road.1: Cairn after cairn, each with a hunter's tag under its top stone.
story.mistinn.card.salt_road.2: They all walked toward the bell.
story.mistinn.card.bell_station.0: The tower on the reef once rang ships home through the fog.
story.mistinn.card.bell_station.1: What tolls it now is no longer a man.
story.mistinn.card.answer.0: You ring the great bell anyway.
story.mistinn.card.answer.1: Long after, an answer comes from beyond the fog.
story.mistinn.card.answer.4: Chapter 3: The Sunken Bell. The end.
story.mistinn.step.pod: Find the pod that came down
story.mistinn.step.pod.hint: The answer came from beyond the fog. The diamond on the minimap marks where it landed.
story.mistinn.step.salt_works.hint: Head inland: the ring of wall on the level ground is the salt works. The diamond on the minimap points to it.
story.mistinn.step.works_bell: Rest at the golden bell by the salt works' gate
story.mistinn.step.works_bell.hint: A golden bell hangs in the stone shrine east of the gate. Right-click to ring it.
story.mistinn.step.yard.hint: The round yard inside the wall. Once you are in, the mist closes the gate behind you.
story.mistinn.step.rust_wheel.hint: Its front is iron and barely feels a blow. Lure it into a pillar and strike its back while it is stuck.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.0: The hatch stands open. Nobody inside. The harness on the seat is still buckled, neatly.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.1: On the pod's wall, a radio is lit.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.2: ...Number 3412. Rust Anchor heard the fog-bell station's bell.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.3: That bell has not rung in years. The stationmaster says that if someone down there is still alive, we send things down.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.4: What is in the pod is for you. Make it last.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.5: There is a salt works inland. The great brine wheel still turns, but no salt has come up in a long time.
story.mistinn.radio.supply_call.6: Go and see what is holding it up. Bring back the Rust God's salt.
story.mistinn.radio.rust_wheel_end.1: When the wheel stops, the salt stops.
story.mistinn.radio.rust_wheel_end.2: They said one more shift and they would bring me up. How long have I been pushing?
story.mistinn.radio.rust_wheel_end.3: The salt is for the anchor to eat. When the anchor goes hungry, the whole station sinks into the fog.
story.mistinn.radio.rust_wheel_end.4: Once the salt in your hands goes up, they will send another one down to push.
story.mistinn.card.salt_works.0: On level ground inland stands a salt works that boiled salt for a hundred years.
story.mistinn.card.salt_works.1: Its great brine wheel has never stopped.
story.mistinn.card.salt_works.2: It is not water that turns it.
story.mistinn.card.stopped.0: The great wheel has stopped. For the first time, the salt works is quiet.
story.mistinn.card.stopped.1: The Rust God's salt lies on the crust, still warm.
story.mistinn.card.stopped.2: Beyond the fog, an anchor chain groans for a long time.
story.mistinn.card.stopped.3: Chapter 4: The Salt Works. The end.
story.mistinn.step.choose.hint: Right-click a drop station's radio with the salt to send it up in the pod, or take it to the Mist Inn and throw it into the fire. Whichever comes first is how this world ends.
story.mistinn.step.ended.hint: The story of this world has ended. You can go on hunting here.
story.mistinn.radio.station_call.0: ...Number 3412. The salt works' wheel has stopped. The station can feel it.
story.mistinn.radio.station_call.1: Send the Rust God's salt back. Put it in the recovery pod; the crane will move this time.
story.mistinn.radio.station_call.3: Another voice cuts in through the static.
story.mistinn.radio.station_call.5: I'm number 3401. You found my tag. None of us went back.
story.mistinn.radio.station_call.6: There's an inn in the mist. We call it the Mist Inn. Bring the salt here and throw it in the fire.
story.mistinn.radio.station_call.7: Send it up, and they'll lower someone else.
story.mistinn.radio.anchor_end.0: The salt goes into the recovery pod. The hatch closes, and this time the crane moves.
story.mistinn.radio.anchor_end.1: Received. The anchor has eaten. The station holds.
story.mistinn.radio.anchor_end.3: Far off, a bell rings three times.
story.mistinn.radio.inn_end.0: The salt falls into the fire. The flames turn blue, and white smoke comes off it.
story.mistinn.radio.inn_end.2: That night, beyond the fog, the anchor chain groans for a long time.
story.mistinn.card.the_call.0: The Rust God's salt is still in your hands.
story.mistinn.card.the_call.1: Rust Anchor is waiting for it.
story.mistinn.card.the_call.2: In the fog, one lamp is waiting too.
story.mistinn.card.anchor.2: When number 3413 wakes, it is beside a drop station no one has used in years.
story.mistinn.card.inn.0: After that day, no pod ever came down again.
story.mistinn.card.inn.2: But the Mist Inn's lamp stayed lit.
achievement.mistinn.ending_anchor.desc: Send the Rust God's salt up
achievement.mistinn.ending_inn.desc: Throw the Rust God's salt into the Mist Inn's fire
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.0: ...This is Rust Anchor. Drop station one-one-seven, signal restored.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.1: Envoy No. 3412, this line only receives. Just listen.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.2: Your pod missed its mark. By our records you should not have woken at that ruin.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.3: It does not matter. You are alive, and the mission stands.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.4: Head for the coast. There is a dead lighthouse there. We call it the fog-shore lighthouse.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.5: Something keeps its lamp room. The station calls it the Snuffer. It holds the Rust God's salt.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.6: Take the salt, bring it to any drop station and put it in the recovery pod. The anchor cannot wait long.
story.mistinn.radio.first_call.7: ...There is a golden bell at the lighthouse door. Rest there before you climb. That is advice, not an order.
story.mistinn.radio.snuffer_end.2: When the light shines, they send more of you.
story.mistinn.radio.snuffer_end.3: Did you think... you were sent...?
story.mistinn.radio.no_answer.0: You put the salt in the recovery pod. The hatch closes. The crane does not move.
story.mistinn.radio.no_answer.1: Nothing on the radio but static.
story.mistinn.radio.no_answer.2: You wait a long time. No one answers.
message.mistinn.repair.no_armor: You are not wearing body armour to mend.
message.mistinn.repair.no_helmet: You are not wearing a helmet to mend.
message.mistinn.repair.whole: That piece is whole; there is nothing to mend.
message.mistinn.repair.poor: %s patched, but it will never be what it was: durability %s / %s
message.mistinn.repair.red: %s like new, though the rust sits a little deeper: durability %s / %s
message.mistinn.injector.used: The cold dose spreads through your veins.
message.mistinn.painkillers.used: The pain goes far away. For %s seconds you will not feel what is destroyed.
message.mistinn.painkillers.worn_off: The painkillers wear off. It all comes back.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_3.usage: Mends the worn body armour: tier III or lower, 50% of its current maximum in 5 s; above III, only 25%, takes 10% of its original maximum for good, 15 s. Single use.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_3.lore.1: The canvas tool roll a Rust Anchor guard carries: rivets, straps and a little tin of salt oil.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_3.lore.2: It mends gear of its own grade; anything finer it can only patch.
item.mistinn.helmet_repair_kit_3.usage: Mends the worn helmet: tier III or lower, 50% of its current maximum in 5 s; above III, only 25%, takes 10% of its original maximum for good, 15 s. Single use.
item.mistinn.helmet_repair_kit_3.lore.1: The canvas tool roll a Rust Anchor guard carries: rivets, straps and a little tin of salt oil.
item.mistinn.helmet_repair_kit_3.lore.2: It mends gear of its own grade; anything finer it can only patch.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_4.usage: Mends the worn body armour: tier IV or lower, 50% of its current maximum in 5 s; above IV, only 25%, takes 10% of its original maximum for good, 10 s. Single use.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_4.lore.1: A mistwalker's tool roll, mist-crystal dust sewn into its lining.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_4.lore.2: On finer gear the hands slow down, and the gear loses something.

item.mistinn.helmet_repair_kit_4.lore.1: A mistwalker's tool roll, mist-crystal dust sewn into its lining.
item.mistinn.helmet_repair_kit_4.lore.2: On finer gear the hands slow down, and the gear loses something.
item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_5.usage: Mends the worn body armour: tier V or lower, 50% of its current maximum in 5 s; above V, only 25%, takes 10% of its original maximum for good, 7 s. Single use.

item.mistinn.armor_repair_kit_5.lore.2: It mends almost anything; only the rust god's work strains it.

item.mistinn.surgery_kit.lore.2: What is sewn back moves, but never quite does as it is told.
item.mistinn.painkillers.usage: 2 s to take; for 90 s destroyed parts are not felt: no slowing, no weakness, a roll even on dead legs. While any part is destroyed, each roll or dive costs 18 health shared over the whole body. 4 doses.
item.mistinn.painkillers.lore.1: A small white bottle of bitter, numbing tablets; brine has long since blurred the label.
item.mistinn.painkillers.lore.2: The pain is still there. It is only kept somewhere else for now.

notice.mistinn.heading: Above: %s Mistinn updates. Press T and scroll up to read them all; the README and the guide tell more.
notice.mistinn.coop: Major skills are the team's; hunters no longer hurt each other (/gamerule pvp true turns it back on); names have colours and the minimap shows teammates; three hunters at most.
notice.mistinn.downed: With a teammate standing, a killing blow puts you down: within a minute they hold F beside you or press H to drag you, ten seconds to bring you back.
notice.mistinn.beacons: New: marker beacons (torch, iron ingot, stick), and redstone soil that breeds redstone: grassy patches on the surface and veins in the dirt (in newly generated chunks only), or craft it from four dirt, bone meal and an iron nugget.
notice.mistinn.quick: Hold R for a wheel of what your pockets and rig hold, used where it lies; B opens the guide.
notice.mistinn.bags: Backpacks and rigs no longer go into the grid (any inside were taken out); on Easy and Normal everyone gets some medicine once.
notice.mistinn.enchant: The mod's weapons and armour take enchantments now, and heavy blows count Sharpness and Fire Aspect.
notice.mistinn.recipes: The guide has a Crafting bookmark: every recipe with its grid and a description.
notice.mistinn.controls: The grid takes the usual inventory controls now: right-click for half or one, shift-click into a chest, number keys and F to swap, Q for one, a double click to gather. Pickups go to the hotbar first, then the pockets, the backpack and the rig. Bring the wheel back to the middle and let go of R to put it away.
notice.mistinn.story_shared: The story is the team's now: one hunter's objective done moves everyone on, with the same lines and cards (a teammate far off gets the lines, and the card once out of a fight); a hunter who was away catches up on arrival. Achievements are told in the chat.
notice.mistinn.pings: Press G to mark whatever is under the crosshair (a place, a creature or a thing on the ground) for the whole team, in view and on the minimap, for twelve seconds.
notice.mistinn.raids: Mind the shore at night: pirates may row in and land. Beat them and the shore is held; at dawn the rest go back to the sea. New achievements: Sharpshooter, Shore Held, Fleet Breaker.
notice.mistinn.elites: Some creatures have stayed too long in the fog and become elites: golden names and affixes (Swift, Ironclad, Hulking, Bloodthirsty, Mistwalker, Volatile, Warchief). They pay more salt and may drop supplies. See page 28 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.tide: Some nights bring a fog tide: a bell tolls far off and the fog stays all night; creatures walk out of it, elites twice as often, and pirates land more readily. Last till dawn without falling and you are through. See page 29 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.gear_lines: Every tier has two more lines of gear. Light pieces (helmet, armour, pack) stop and hold less, but are quiet, never slow you and let stamina come back faster; heavy ones (helmet, armour, rig, pack) stop and hold more, but are slower, louder and hard on the breath, and heavy armour slows your swing. The tooltip lists what each costs.
notice.mistinn.throwables: New throwables: a salt bomb staggers creatures near it and breaks off their windups; a flare burns for half a minute and shows creatures through the fog; a bell lure draws idle creatures away. Crafted at the table; see page 31 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.bounty: The anchor station now posts bounties: some mornings an elite of three affixes and twice the life waits far off, marked with a red cross on the minimap. Bring it down for 800 salt, good gear and the new achievement Bounty Hunter; those with you get a share. See page 32 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.supply: The anchor station now takes orders: the guide has a new Supply tab where salt buys medicine, throwables, cartridges and repair kits, dropped near you within a minute. It lands loud and draws whatever is near. See page 33 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.rift: The sky has begun to tear: from a world's fourth day, sky rifts open far off, under a vermilion sky over blood-red water. Three waves fall out of each (from the second on, packs of rift hounds that ring you and lunge from the side, the last pack run by a howling alpha), the last led by its herald. Bring them down to seal it, for 600 salt and the new achievement Sew the Sky Shut; the scar it leaves stays for good. See pages 34, 42 and 47 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.terra: Terra has come: every world holds six crystal highlands 1200 to 3200 blocks from spawn, each in three rings with their own ground and music; crystal drakes circle their skies, crystal lizards lie still on their stone (creep up and offer grit to tame one), a crown elder keeps each heart, crystal squalls now and then cut those out in the open, and the crystal tillers live among the valley's terraces. Wake a settlement's hub with three crystal cores to make a homestead (which some nights the crystal tide comes up against), and press M to open your map and travel between them (minimap zoom moves to N). See pages 35 to 41 and 43 to 46 of the guide.
notice.mistinn.bells: Golden bells cool for each hunter apart; ringing one restores you and clears harmful effects; every hunter can have a one-time bell remember them once.

[Stats and skills]

Beat a keeper and bring back a rust god salt to learn the first major skill on the guide's skills page: the slide.

After that, salt buys strength, speed, constitution and intellect, a point at a time.

item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.11:
[Heavy Strikes]

Hold right-click with a weapon to charge; let go for a heavy strike that hits everything in front of you.

A full charge breaks off the enemy's attack and rocks it back so it cannot strike for a moment. Charging slows you and costs stamina.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.12:
[The Mist Shore]

Mist stands round the dead lighthouses, thicker the closer you go: at the tower's foot you see a stone's throw, and the map shows only your feet.

There are things in the mist. What follows is what those before you wrote down.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.13:
[Salt Corpse]

A hunter dried in the brine. Slow, and hard.

A salt corpse that falls is not always dead. Strike it again while it lies.

The ones lying by the lighthouses are not just bodies either.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.14:
[Lamp Thrall]

A shadow with a little blue lamp. When the flame turns orange, it is about to rush you.

Roll aside, or break it off with a full heavy strike the moment it stops.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.15:
[Mist Shade]

A shape only seen in the mist. One blow undoes it; its touch takes your sight for a moment.

Out of the mist it comes apart. When a keeper's lamps go out, they come too.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.16:
[Lamp Oil]

Lamp thralls often carry a small flask of oil.

Halfway up the lighthouse a golden bell has gone dark. It takes no one until oil lights it.

Whoever lights it rests there.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.17:
[Named Weapons]

A weapon with a name answers only a hunter who has earned it.

Short of that, it hits at half strength, swings slowly and gives no heavy blow.

Its tooltip says what it asks: a stat, or a keeper slain.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.18:

Lantern Staff: Intellect 4. Sets all ahead alight. Soul lantern and sticks.

Tide Maul: Strength 5, Constitution 3. Throws back all around you. Bell, iron blocks, sticks.

staff.mistinn.quartermaster.title: Quartermaster
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.kit.0: Number 3412? Just in time, I kept your share. Stop gawking, recruits all look the same.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.kit.1: Armour, rig, pack, mask: one of each in the chest. Take them and put them on. No returns.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.kit.2: Ask me how to pack once you're dressed. If it doesn't fit the grid, it doesn't fit. Haggling won't help.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.hello.0: Missing something? Don't expect me to hand out extra.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.tiers.0: Look at the colour of the diamond before the name. N is plain; I to VI, each better than the last.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.tiers.1: Good gear lasts longer, covers more and carries more. Don't think VI makes you immortal. Out there, nothing cares what you wear.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.cover.0: Armour only guards what it covers. Helmet for the head, chest plate for the torso, leggings and boots for the rest.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.cover.1: You're six parts, each counted on its own. Lose any three and you're down. Whatever it doesn't cover, you'd better dodge for.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.ask.grid: How does the grid pack work?
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.grid.0: Press E to open it. Everything takes its own number of cells; pick it up and press R to turn it.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.grid.1: Shift-click sends things from your pack into an open chest, or to the hotbar with none open; from a chest they go to the hotbar first, then your pack. Right-click takes half; number keys and F swap with the hotbar and your offhand. Point at what you don't want and press Q for one, Ctrl and Q for the stack.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.grid.2: The bottom row is the safe box. When you fall, what's in the safe box stays with you; the rest goes into the gravestone where you fell.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.mask.0: The mask goes on apart from the helmet. Right-click the helmet slot in your inventory and it turns into the mask slot.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.mask.1: Don't complain it's stuffy. Better on than off.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.ask.station: How long have you been here?
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.station.0: Long enough to lose count of the kits I've handed out.
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.station.1: Every one logged: number, size, date issued. The returned column...
staff.mistinn.quartermaster.station.2: ...Why do you ask? As long as it fits.
staff.mistinn.roommate.title: Bunkmate
staff.mistinn.roommate.hello.0: Awake? Sleep any longer and you'll miss breakfast. It's drop day for both of us, you know.
staff.mistinn.roommate.hello.1: I go one shift before you. Once I'm down there, you'll be the senior one in this room, ha.
staff.mistinn.roommate.scared.0: Of course. I counted three hundred sheep last night.
staff.mistinn.roommate.scared.1: But the lighthouses out there are going dark one by one. Someone has to light them.
staff.mistinn.roommate.scared.2: ...Don't tell the instructor I said I was scared.
staff.mistinn.roommate.ask.before: What about the ones before us?
staff.mistinn.roommate.before.0: The last lot? Busy out there, I suppose.
staff.mistinn.roommate.before.1: The bell keeper says everyone who goes down can hear the station's bell. Hear it, and you know where home is.
staff.mistinn.roommate.came.0: By boat. ...It was a boat, I think.
staff.mistinn.roommate.came.1: All I remember is waking up in this bunk with the number tag round my neck. You too, right?
staff.mistinn.cook.title: Cook
staff.mistinn.cook.hello.0: Nobody fights on an empty stomach! Here, a bowl of hot soup, kelp and a pinch of salt.
staff.mistinn.cook.hello.1: Salt's precious, mind. Out there they spend it like money.
staff.mistinn.cook.salt.0: Things out there leave salt when they fall, the fiercer the more. Salt you find in ruins turns into salt when you use it.
staff.mistinn.cook.salt.1: You spend it to learn skills and raise your stats.
staff.mistinn.cook.salt.2: But when you fall, the salt on you turns to residue and stays where you fell. Go back for it.
staff.mistinn.cook.food.1: The supply boat didn't come last month, so it's fish this month too.
staff.mistinn.cook.gossip.0: Word is Winch hasn't said a word in three days. Oh, wait. Winch never says a word.
staff.mistinn.cook.gossip.1: The radio room picked up something odd last night. Helm told Static to stop listening to it.
staff.mistinn.cook.ask.station: How long have you been here?
staff.mistinn.cook.station.0: I grew up here. My mother cooked here too.
staff.mistinn.cook.station.1: Hardly anyone here comes from outside. ...Except you hunters. You came by boat, didn't you? I've never once seen that boat.
staff.mistinn.smith.title: Smith
staff.mistinn.smith.hello.1: A blade isn't for looking at. Swing it.
staff.mistinn.smith.branches.0: A straight blade is quick, a slanting cut. A greatsword is slow; what it cleaves stops. A spear reaches, in a straight line.
staff.mistinn.smith.branches.1: A dagger cuts twice at once, up close. A hammer sweeps and knocks things away. A scythe takes both hands and reaches widest.
staff.mistinn.smith.branches.2: The material decides how good: wood, stone, iron, diamond, netherite. Netherite you get by upgrading diamond at a smithing table.
staff.mistinn.smith.heavy.0: Hold right-click to charge, let go to strike. The longer you charge, the harder it lands, on everything in its reach.
staff.mistinn.smith.heavy.1: It costs twice the stamina and wears the blade twice as much. Rolling breaks your own charge.
staff.mistinn.smith.special.0: The Snuffer's Hook, the Lantern Staff, the Tide Maul. They can be made, but they choose who holds them. In the wrong hands they barely swing.
staff.mistinn.smith.special.1: What they ask for is written on them. Read it.
staff.mistinn.instructor.title: Drill instructor
staff.mistinn.instructor.hello.0: Stand straight. Heels together. ...Never mind. Nobody out there cares how you stand.
staff.mistinn.instructor.stamina.0: Swings, sprints, rolls, they all eat stamina. Run dry and you stand there waiting.
staff.mistinn.instructor.stamina.1: Out there, whoever stands waiting dies.
staff.mistinn.instructor.roll.0: Press the roll key. For a moment in the roll, nothing can cut you.
staff.mistinn.instructor.roll.1: With a bad leg you can only dive, and a dive dodges nothing.
staff.mistinn.instructor.slide.0: Crouch while you sprint and slide under them.
staff.mistinn.instructor.slide.1: You have to learn it: bring back a rust god's salt and learn it on the skill page of your guide.
staff.mistinn.instructor.ask.windup: How do I read their attacks?
staff.mistinn.instructor.windup.0: Before they strike they crouch and cry out. See it, hear it, roll. Cut when they recover.
staff.mistinn.instructor.windup.1: Lose both legs and they will come to finish you. Don't let it happen.
staff.mistinn.instructor.ask.why: How many have you sent off?
staff.mistinn.scout.title: Scout
staff.mistinn.scout.hearing.0: Swings, heavy blows, rolls, slides and sprints all make noise. Crouch and it's quieter.
staff.mistinn.scout.hearing.1: Ringing a bell or treating a wound is loud, crouching or not. When they hear, they come to look.
staff.mistinn.scout.smell.0: Blood carries far, farther the more of you is broken. Stop the bleeding first.
staff.mistinn.scout.ask.pack: What if a pack surrounds me?
staff.mistinn.scout.pack.0: Three or more won't rush you together. Two come in, the rest circle.
staff.mistinn.scout.pack.1: The turn goes to whichever is behind you. Keep your back to a wall.
staff.mistinn.scout.ask.stare: What if I stare at them?
staff.mistinn.scout.stare.0: The walking dead stop when you stare at them from afar. Turn away and they come.
staff.mistinn.scout.stare.1: It won't hold long. Three seconds, at most.
staff.mistinn.scout.outside.0: Only as far as the watchposts.
staff.mistinn.scout.outside.1: ...It's quiet out there. Far quieter than here.
staff.mistinn.doctor.title: Doctor
staff.mistinn.doctor.hello.0: Sit. Where does it hurt? ...Coming before you're hurt. Good.
staff.mistinn.doctor.body.0: Head, torso, both arms, both legs: six parts, each on its own. Any three at zero and you're down.
staff.mistinn.doctor.body.1: A part at zero is dead: hands can't hold, legs can't carry.
staff.mistinn.doctor.bleed.0: Bites and cuts can open a bleed. A bleeding part slowly dies.
staff.mistinn.doctor.bleed.1: A tourniquet stops it, but left on too long it hurts the limb too.
staff.mistinn.doctor.fracture.0: Falls, blasts and heavy blows can break bones. A broken leg only dives.
staff.mistinn.doctor.fracture.1: A splint holds it for now; only a surgery kit really sets it.
staff.mistinn.doctor.meds.0: Painkillers hide what a wound does, not the wound. A potent injector brings a part back slowly. A part at zero only surgery saves.
staff.mistinn.doctor.meds.1: Each takes a few seconds. Get hit, or roll, and it's broken off.
staff.mistinn.doctor.patients.0: Everyone here comes to me with their aches.
staff.mistinn.doctor.patients.1: You hunters... I only ever see you once, before you leave.
staff.mistinn.archivist.title: Archivist
staff.mistinn.archivist.hello.0: Number 3412. I remember your number. I remember everyone's.
staff.mistinn.archivist.guide.0: Right-click to open it. Eleven pages: the world, the mission, the rules. After them, stats, skills and achievements.
staff.mistinn.archivist.guide.1: Read it well. Nobody out there will tell you twice.
staff.mistinn.archivist.stats.0: Strength, speed, constitution, intellect, raised point by point with salt.
staff.mistinn.archivist.stats.1: Strength hits harder, speed rolls farther, constitution lets each part take more. Intellect... some weapons only answer to the clever.
staff.mistinn.archivist.skills.0: Common salt opens the small nodes, a rust god's salt the great ones. The first great skill is the slide.
staff.mistinn.archivist.achievements.0: Sixteen. Each shows at the top right when earned and pays its salt; they are all in your advancements (L), on the hunter's tab.
staff.mistinn.archivist.achievements.1: I copy everyone's into the ledger. ...Most people's pages are very short.
staff.mistinn.archivist.map.0: The minimap is top right, north up, showing your heading, your bell and where you fell. M changes the zoom.
staff.mistinn.archivist.map.1: K opens the mission log. Everything said over the radio is in it.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.title: Bell keeper
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.hello.0: Come here, child, let me look at you. ...Hm. As young as the others.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.bell.0: Ring it and, when you fall, you'll wake here.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.bell.1: A bell rung must rest an hour before it rings again. There are bells out there too. Find them.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.death.0: The salt on you turns to residue, and your things go into a gravestone where you fell. Go back and use it to take them all.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.death.1: But fall again first... and the old residue is gone.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.wall.0: Every name... no, every number, is here.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.wall.1: I wipe it every day. Whichever plate I'm wiping, I talk to it a while.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.return.1: The station's bell rings three times, and everyone who went down hears it.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.ask.light: The lamp atop the bell tower
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.light.0: Every light out there has gone dark. Only this one still burns.
staff.mistinn.bell_keeper.light.1: While it burns, it can be seen.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.title: Radio apprentice
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.hello.0: Hey! You're 3412? Helm was just calling your number.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.radio.0: If a drop station's radio is dead, mend it with 4 redstone.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.radio.1: Then you'll hear Helm, but it only receives. Nothing you say reaches us.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.helm.0: Helm is Helm. Every announcement, every order in the station comes from Helm.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.helm.1: Three years here and I've never seen Helm, only heard the voice. ...A lovely voice.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.static.1: Sometimes there's someone talking in it, far off and quiet. Helm says it's an echo.
staff.mistinn.crane_operator.title: Crane operator
staff.mistinn.crane_operator.pod.0: Sit. Button. Door shuts, I let go.
staff.mistinn.crane_operator.ask.count: How many have you let go?

staff.mistinn.dock_worker_1.hello.0: Mind out, recruit, this one's heavy!
staff.mistinn.dock_worker_2.title: Dock hand
staff.mistinn.dock_worker_2.hello.0: Fish again. Seventh crate of fish this week.
staff.mistinn.dock_worker_3.title: Dock hand
staff.mistinn.dock_worker_3.hello.0: The fog's a little closer than yesterday. Can you tell?
staff.mistinn.dock_worker_4.title: Dock hand
staff.mistinn.dock_worker_4.hello.0: I'm waiting for the supply boat. It'll come.
staff.mistinn.radio_operator.bark.0: Kssh... kssh... did you hear that?

item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.19:
[Fog-Bell Station]

On a reef in the shallows, rarer than a lighthouse.

A golden bell where the boats tied up; the higher the floor, the better the stores. The Sunken Bell waits under the great bell on top.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.20:
[The Sunken Bell]

A toll rolls a ring along the floor: jump it or roll.

Each toll thickens the mist; at four layers, three tolls. Its bell hums first.

A full heavy blow rings its own bell and thins the mist.
message.mistinn.sunken_bell.sealed: The mist closes the way you came.
message.mistinn.rust_wheel.sealed: The mist closes the way you came.
subtitles.mistinn.entity.sunken_bell.bel: The Sunken Bell crouches, its bell gurgling
item.mistinn.bell_clapper.lore.1: The Sunken Bell's own tongue. Strike with it and even its bell answers.
item.mistinn.rust_rim.lore.1: A length of the Rust Wheel's rim. Once it rolls, it does not stop.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.21:
[Bell Clapper]

The Sunken Bell slain; strength 4.

A full heavy blow rings out all round and breaks off every windup within six blocks, struck or not.

Dropped by the Sunken Bell.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.22:
[Salt Works]

On level ground inland, rarer than a lighthouse: a walled round yard with four stone pillars.

Outside the gate, a golden bell, the boiling house with its stores, and the salt pans. The Rust Wheel waits in the middle.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.23:
[The Rust Wheel]

Its iron front shrugs off blows; its back, the axle and the man, is soft.

After a spin it rolls straight at you, faster each run; the ◆ on its bar is its momentum. Lure it into a pillar: stuck, one full heavy blow throws it off balance.

Linger at its back and the man lashes his chain.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.24:
[Rust Rim]

The Rust Wheel slain; constitution 4.

A full heavy blow rolls you on some six blocks, running over all in the path and throwing them aside; a wall stops you, dazed.

Dropped by the Rust Wheel.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.25:
[Pirates of the Fog Sea]

Sail far out of sight of land and in time a horn sounds in the fog. A black-sailed ship heaves to, broadside on, with a warning shot.

While a gunner lives its guns fire; a marksman's lock clicks before the shot, so move.

Ladders come up the hull.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.26:
[Taking a Ship]

The captain falls and the ship is yours; the crew jump overboard.

The stern cabin's chest holds their loot, at times a treasure map; the hold keeps stores.

Each ship taken makes the next crews harder: the stars on the bar, four at most. Leave if you must; they wait.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.27:
[Flintlock and Pistol]

Hold use to aim (steadier the longer you hold), let go to fire one paper cartridge, then reload.

The musket reaches far and hits hard; the pistol comes up quicker.

Paper cartridges: paper, gunpowder and an iron nugget make three. Captains carry pistols.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.28:
[Elites]

Some creatures stayed too long in the fog: a golden name, gold dust, more life, and affixes.

A Mistwalker steps out behind you. A Volatile one bursts as it dies: back off. A Warchief drives the rest on: kill it first.

Elites pay more salt.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.29:
[The Fog Tide]

Some nights the fog does not lift. A bell tolls far off and it rolls in on every side.

Creatures walk out of it, elites twice as often, and pirates land more readily.

Hold out till dawn and it ebbs.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.30:
[Light and Heavy]

Each tier has two more lines.

Light: less armour and room, but no slowing, quieter, easier on the breath.

Heavy: more of both, but slower, louder, harder on the breath.

A whole set gives more. The tooltip tells all.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.31:
[Throwables]

Use to throw.

Salt bomb: staggers what is near and breaks its windup; loud.

Flare: burns half a minute, shows the creatures near it.

Bell lure: rings, drawing idle creatures.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.32:
[Bounties]

Some mornings the anchor station posts a bounty: an elite of three affixes and twice the life, far off.

The red cross on the minimap marks it; it shows when you come near.

Its killer is paid, those near share. Three days, then it is withdrawn.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.33:
[Supply Drops]

The Supply tab buys medicine and throwables from the anchor station for salt.

Click twice to order; one at a time. Soon a barrel falls near you.

It lands loud, and draws whatever is near.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.34:
[Sky Rifts]

From day four the sky may tear open far off, searing the ground red and the water to blood.

Near it three waves fall, the herald last: at half it roars, strikes in lines, steps out behind you. Down all to seal it.

The scar stays, walked at night. Unfought, it widens.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.35:
[Terra]

Far from spawn lie six highlands where living crystal grows through the rock.

A waste of crystal veins rings a valley of jade grass and mist pines; at the heart, lattice spires.

Outcrops give crystal grit; the grass hides crystal sprouts.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.36:
[Crystal Drakes]

Terra's skies are kept by drakes of living crystal, fleshless.

They circle high and stoop to bite: a shriek, a spreading shadow. Shots and spears glance off; greatswords and hammers crack them.

Shattered, they leave grit, now and then a core.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.37:
[Tillers and Homesteads]

In each Terra valley stands a settlement of crystal tillers, with facilities nothing can break.

Their keeper trades for grit and cores. Hurt one and all turn on you.

Give the hub core three crystal cores: it wakes, and the settlement is your homestead.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.38:
[The Way Home]

M opens your map of all you have seen, homesteads marked.

Click one to go. From another homestead it is free; from the wild, stand still 8 s and spend a chip.

Moving or harm breaks it. Then wait 2 minutes.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.39:
[The Crown Elder]

An elder drake keeps each Terra's heart. Rings of light mark where the lattice erupts; hurt, it calls two drakes.

Below half it lands to sweep and charge: lure a charge into a spire to stun it.

Its cores wake a hub; it regrows in three days.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.40:
[Lizards and Hounds]

Crystal lizards lie still on the vein stone in threes, like an outcrop, and spring together when you come close. Each bite wears your armour.

Rift hounds ring you as a pack; only one at your side or back lunges. Keep them in sight.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.41:
[Crystal Squalls]

At times a highland's wind turns and its crystal rings; a squall breaks, for a minute or two.

Open sky cuts you and wears your helmet; a roof, deck, tree or ledge keeps you safe.

Out in the open it brings down grit, at times a lattice chip.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.42:
[Rift Alphas]

Some packs run behind an alpha: bigger, red-named, always in a rift's last wave.

It stops to howl; the pack quickens and the two farthest apart leap at once, whichever way you face.

Fell it and the pack runs a while. At night the scars ring with howls.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.43:
[Crystal Tides]

Some nights a homestead is besieged: the fields ring, then three waves of lizards come up round the hub, drakes with the last two.

Each comes when the last is down. Hold all three for the tillers' salt and a core.

At dawn what is left crumbles away.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.44:
[The Tillers' Tools]

The trading elder sells two tools.

Whetstone: an edge of grit; for three minutes your blows on drakes and lizards are not turned, and bite deeper.

Resonance fork: strike it and drakes and lizards near glow a while, even those lying still.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.45:
[Lizard Companions]

Crouch up to a lizard lying still: it stirs only at your side. Offer it grit; one time in three it takes it.

It follows, bites what you fight and what fights you, and lies in wait when you stand.

Crouch and use an empty hand to have it stay. Grit mends it.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.46:
[A Homestead Grows]

Give a woken hub more cores to grow it: 3, 5, then 8.

1: its fields send grit each morning; take it from the hub by hand.

2: a second warden, more grit.

3: the way home here rests half as long; siege thanks double.
item.mistinn.hunter_guide.page.47:
[Rift Beacon]

Five rift shards round a crystal core, an iron ingot beneath, bind a beacon.

Hold it up three seconds and the sky tears a long walk off, as a rift would of itself.

Overworld only; it does not answer while a rift hangs open.
